chapter: San Francisco, the So Different Orchestra and Johnny
title: The Portola Louvre in San Francisco and neighboring bands
summary: The band plays two years in the basement of the Portola Louvre at Powell and Market while Art Hickman and Paul Ash play nearby.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: were there a coupla years, and Art Hickman was playing right up the street from us, and Art Hickman was playing right up the street from us at the St. Francis Hotel, and all of their gang used to come down and listen at us all the time when...on their...during their intermission. Paul Ash was across the street, and the... Portola Louvre! That was the name of the big nightclub right at the... where the street...Powell and Market comes together, where the car turns around there.
